eventLocation: Rasi Engineering College, Vanjuvancheri near Oragadam, Kanchipuram District.
eventDescription: Vidhaigal Organization, in association with the Pollution Control Board, Oragadam, successfully organized a tree plantation drive today at the campus of Rasi Engineering College, located in Vanjuvancheri near Oragadam, Kanchipuram District. A total of 500 native trees were planted as part of this initiative.
